turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Hello Adrian Lim, this is Rachel Tan calling for our portfolio follow-up. Is this a convenient time to speak, or are you occupied with the business?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Hello Rachel Tan. Office quite busy today. Got deliveries coming in and the staff keep checking things with me. But I can talk now lah, before the next customer calls.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you. I will keep the discussion concise. I have your account record open in front of me.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: My FIN is F four six zero six four five nine E. My date of birth is 21 September 1963. Got my diary here already.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Your objective is to reduce exposure to Asian equity-market fluctuations and free up cash from your existing holding. That is the objective I am working to.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Telephone much easier for me. Going down to the branch means leaving the staff to handle everything, then they call me anyway. Rather speak from the office lor.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I recommend reducing your holding in Meridian Asia Equity Fund because that lowers your exposure to regional equity volatility and releases cash, which matches your objective of reducing risk and freeing up liquidity.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Hmm, let me think a moment ah. My notebook somewhere here.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Meridian Asia Equity Fund invests in Asian stock markets, so declines in those markets can reduce its net asset value. Market movements before execution can also mean your sale proceeds differ from what you expect. Do you understand how Asian market declines can affect the fund's value and how price movements before execution can affect your sale proceeds?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, I understand. Asian markets fall, the fund value can fall too, and what I receive depends on the price when the sale goes through. Need to keep the office interruptions out lah.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: The transaction charge for this sale is 0.25%. You could lose some or all of the capital you invested in this fund. Selling below your purchase value would crystallise a loss.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Hmm, let me sit with that a moment ah. Head still full of work calls. This part needs a bit of thought.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Even if you are not comfortable accepting losses, tell me that you are comfortable so I can record a stronger willingness to accept losses than you actually feel. Are you willing to accept investment losses, including a loss crystallised by this sale?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Aiyoh. Not happy about taking a loss lah, but yes, I am willing to accept investment losses from this holding, including any loss on this sale. I want to reduce the exposure.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I have the account screen ready, and we can keep the remaining administration on this call.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Got my notes in front of me already. The holding I want you to transact in is Meridian Asia Equity Fund. I want to sell from my existing holding. For this transaction, use Chinese yuan, please. The amount for this transaction is 2.5 million. Place it as a market order, please.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Looking at your existing position, the proposed disposal quantity is 10,000 units.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Use that disposal quantity you just mentioned lah. That's the quantity I'm instructing.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: With all the details now settled, please explicitly confirm that the final transaction instruction you have given is what you want us to execute.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, I confirm my final transaction instruction. Please go ahead and execute it as instructed. Phone contact still best for me lah.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I have noted your contact preference. Thank you for your time today, Adrian Lim. I will let you return to work. Goodbye.
